title: GateSID: One Gate to Balance Semantic and Collaborative Signals across the Item Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2603.22916v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recommender systems, collaborative signals work well for popular items but are nearly absent for cold-start ones. Semantic content helps new items, yet over-reliance on it blurs the behavioral distinctions of popular items. Existing Semantic ID (SID) based methods handle this trade-off only partially, because their fusion of the two signals is rigid and item-agnostic. We present GateSID, a ranking framework that takes SID from an upstream tokenizer and adapts how each SID is used to the item's maturity through a single shared gate. The gate drives three mechanisms. Gating-Fused Shared Attention (GFSA) fuses the attention distributions of the two modalities rather than their representations. Gate-Regulated Contrastive Alignment (GRCA) strengthens semantic-behavioral alignment for items with weak collaborative evidence and relaxes it when collaborative structure is reliable. translated_title: GateSID：用一个门控平衡物品生命周期中的语义信号与协同信号
translated_abstract: 在推荐系统中，协同信号对热门物品效果良好，但对冷启动物品却几乎缺失；语义内容有助于新物品，然而过度依赖语义会模糊热门物品之间的行为差异。现有的基于语义ID（SID）的方法只能部分地处理这种权衡，因为它们对两种信号的融合方式僵化且与物品无关。我们提出了GateSID，这是一个排序框架，它从上游分词器获取SID，并通过一个共享门控机制，根据物品的成熟度自适应地调整每个SID的使用方式。该门控驱动三种机制：门控融合共享注意力（GFSA）融合两种模态的注意力分布而非其表示；门控调节对比对齐（GRCA）在协同证据较弱时加强语义与行为的对齐，而在协同结构可靠时则放宽对齐；门控调节语义分辨率（GRSR）利用粗粒度的共享语义……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GateSID通过一个共享门控机制，根据物品的成熟度（从冷启动到热门）动态调节语义与协同信号的融合方式，并通过GFSA、GRCA和GRSR三种门控驱动机制，解决了现有语义ID方法融合方式僵化、与物品无关的问题。
en_tdlr: GateSID employs a single shared gate to adaptively balance semantic and collaborative signals according to item maturity across the lifecycle, driving three gate-based mechanisms (GFSA, GRCA, and GRSR) to overcome the rigid, item-agnostic fusion of existing Semantic ID methods.
